# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 卬# look up at + 日 sun/day → *raise* one's head to observe the sun → *rise* (high); *look up*. Also, *haughty* (← take a superior attitude) and *tense* (← high emotions).
舉也。从日卬聲。

translation.text: To raise. Formed from 日, with 卬 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 仄# incline toward + 日 sun/day → *the sun in the late afternoon sky*; *setting sun* (← incline toward the western horizon).
日在西方時。側也。从日仄聲。《易》曰：“日𣅛之離。”

translation.text: When the sun is in the west: slanting. Formed from 日, with 仄 indicating the sound. The Changes says: “The slanting sun’s brightness.”

entries.text: 大也。从日反聲。

translation.text: Great. Formed from 日, with 反 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 日 here an abbreviated form# of 旬 (cycle/circle) + 比 line up → a figurative or actual circle (of people) → *companions*; *group* → *insect* (← swarm of insects).
同也。从日从比。

translation.text: The same or together. Formed from 日 and 比.

entries.text: As per 升# (raise/rise) + 日 sun/day → rising sun → *rise*.
日上也。从日升聲。古只用升。

translation.text: The sun rising. Formed from 日, with 升 indicating the sound. Ancient writing used only 升.

entries.text: 明也。从日戶聲。

translation.text: Bright. Formed from 日, with 戶 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 方# (spread right and left, or in all directions) + 日 sun/day → sunlight spreading right and left (i.e. all directions; compare 普) at *daybreak* → *clear*. Also, *beginning* (← daybreak as the beginning of a new day).
明也。从日方聲。

translation.text: Bright. Formed from 日, with 方 indicating the sound.

entries.text: Originally, an abbreviated form# of 昜 (bright) + 曰 say/speech indicator → chant/recite in a *bright*/*clear* voice → *prosper* (← bright conditions). A seal inscription form simplifies the character to 曰 + 日 sun/day.
美言也。从日从曰。一曰日光也。《詩》曰：“東方昌矣。”

translation.text: Fine words. Formed from 日 and 曰. Another explanation: sunlight. The Odes says: “The east is bright.”

entries.text: Originally, 月 moon + 向# (ventilation hole) → *bright* moonlight streaming through an *open* window, and manifesting the hidden → *brightness*; *light*. Extended meanings from the idea of the light of dawn (signaling the end of one day and the start of the next) include *spend/pass* (the night); *be visible*; *the next/following* (day/week/year); *begin*; *end*; and *dawn*. *Disclose* and *confide* are extended senses of "open" (open up to), as are *clarity*; *evident* and *obvious*. *Be conversant with* is via the idea of illumination, here with respect to a particular subject matter. The reading ミン refers to the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644).

The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows the character was originally 昬, which is 民# (blind) + 日 sun/day → dark night/*darkness* in which nothing can be seen → *evening*; *sunset*; *nightfall* → *blind*; *blindness*.
日冥也。从日氐省。氐者，下也。一曰民聲。

translation.text: The sun darkening. Formed from 日 and abbreviated 氐; 氐 means below. Another explanation: 民 indicates the sound.

entries.text: 尚冥也。从日勿聲。

translation.text: Still dark. Formed from 日, with 勿 indicating the sound.

entries.text: The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines 彡 pattern + a rudimentary depiction of a lizard → lizard stretched flat on the ground in sunning itself. *Easy* and *peaceful* are extended meanings (← be at ease/peace) with *make light of* and *control/rule* (with ease) by further extension. *Change* and *exchange* are borrowed meanings → *divination* (← change continuously). Distinguish 易 from 昜 (sun rising high in the sky).
蜥易，蝘蜓，守宮也。象形。《祕書》說：日月爲易，象陰陽也。一曰从勿。凡易之屬皆从易。

translation.text: The lizard, 蜥易 or 蝘蜓, also called 守宮. Pictographic. The Secret Writings explains: 日 and 月 make 易, representing yin and yang. Another explanation: it follows 勿. All characters in this group follow 易.

entries.text: The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 日 sun/day + a representation of one object layered on another → passage of days/time (likened to a figurative piling up; compare 昨 and 時) → *antiquity*; (previous) *night*.
乾肉也。从殘肉，日以晞之。與俎同意。

translation.text: Dried meat. Formed from pieces of meat, with 日 drying them. It uses the same principle as 俎.

entries.text: 旦明，日將出也。从日斤聲。讀若希。

translation.text: Dawn light, when the sun is about to rise. Formed from 日, with 斤 indicating the sound. Read like 希.

entries.text: The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 日 sun/day + a T-shaped form suggesting "rise straight" → sun rising high → *rise* → *open (out)* (← raise in opening out). A bronzeware inscription form adds 彡 pattern to emphasize the sun's bright rays. Distinguish 昜 from 易.
開也。从日、一、勿。一曰飛揚。一曰長也。一曰彊者眾皃。

translation.text: To open. Formed from 日, 一 and 勿. Another explanation: to fly aloft. Another: long. Another: the appearance of many strong people.

entries.text: The relevant seal inscription form is 晶# (brightness) + 生 (fresh) → fresh, bright, invigorating starlight → *star*. 星 is a scribal form simplification.

As per 央# (stretch) + 日 sun/day → sun stretching/*shining* over a wide area (compare 影) → *reflection*; *projection* (← dark spot attending to sunlight striking an object) → *shade*; *shape*. Also, *match/go with* and *be conspicuous* (← reflect) → *be attractive* (← striking).
明也。隱也。从日央聲。

translation.text: Bright; concealed. Formed from 日, with 央 indicating the sound.

entries.text: The relevant seal inscription form is 屯# (swelling bud) + an element combining 日 sun/day and 艸 grass/plant → *spring* (← season when buds and other vegetation swell in the sunlight that returns after winter) → *youth*; *sexual desire*.
春爲昦天，元气昦昦。从日、夰，夰亦聲。

translation.text: In spring, heaven is called 昦天; the primal vapor is expansive. Formed from 日 and 夰; 夰 also indicates the sound.

entries.text: As per 未# (obscure) + 日 sun/day → things obscure in poor sunlight → *dark* → *ignorant*; *foolish*.
爽，旦明也。从日未聲。一曰闇也。

translation.text: 昧爽, the light of dawn. Formed from 日, with 未 indicating the sound. Another explanation: dark.

entries.text: As per 乍# (create a pile) + 日 sun/day → figurative pile of days (compare 昔 and 時) → *past*; *day/year before*. 昔 and 昨 likely were variants of each other that eventually diverged in usage.
壘日也。从日乍聲。

translation.text: Accumulated days. Formed from 日, with 乍 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 喜樂皃。从日弁聲。

translation.text: A joyful appearance. Formed from 日, with 弁 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 句# (bend) + 日 sun/day → warm sunlight causing plants to wilt → *warm* (v.).
日出溫也。从日句聲。北地有昫衍縣。

translation.text: Warmth from the rising sun. Formed from 日, with 句 indicating the sound. Beidi has Xuyan County, 昫衍.

entries.text: As per 召# (curve) + 日 sun/day → shining arc of light → *shine*; *light up*; *brightness*.
日明也。从日召聲。

translation.text: The sun’s brightness. Formed from 日, with 召 indicating the sound.

entries.text: The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 止# (stand straight) + a spoon/ladle → straight spoon/ladle → *correct*; *just*; *right* (← abstract applications of straightness/uprightness).
直也。从日、正。凡是之屬皆从是。

translation.text: Straight or correct. Formed from 日 and 正. All characters in the 是 category are formed from 是.

entries.text: An abbreviated form# of 翊 (rise) + 日 sun/day → *bright light* given off by the rising sun. *The next/following day* is a borrowed meaning via 翌.
明日也。从日立聲。

translation.text: The next day. Formed from 日, with 立 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 日𣅦也。从日失聲。

translation.text: The sun slanting westward, 𣅦. Formed from 日, with 失 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 卯# (bend) + 日 sun (→ heavenly body) → *the Pleiades* (a hook-shaped constellation).
白虎宿星。从日卯聲。

translation.text: A stellar mansion of the White Tiger. Formed from 日, with 卯 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 尼# (close contact) + 日 (sun → sunlight) → sunlight contacting (objects on) the earth → *intimacy* (compare 怩); *approach*. Compare also 暱.
As per 永# (stretch far) + 日 sun/day → *long day* (← long-lasting day); *long series of days*; *extend*.
日長也。从日、永。會意。

translation.text: A long day. Formed from 日 and 永, combining their meanings.

entries.text: As per 兆# (split) + 日 sun/day → *dawn*; *early morning* (← the sun splitting away from the horizon).
As per 寺# (stand straight by) + 日 sun/day → straightforward procession of the sun through the sky → *time*; *hour*; *calendar* (compare 昔 and 昨).
四時也。从日寺聲。

translation.text: The four seasons. Formed from 日, with 寺 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 光# (light extending from a torch) + 日 sun/day → bright sunlight (compare 曠 and 旺) extending over the land → *shining*; *clear*.
明也。从日光聲。

translation.text: Bright. Formed from 日, with 光 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 亘# (circle about) + 日 sun/day → circle of objects being dried in *bright* sunlight → *dry in the sun*. Compare 烜.
進也。日出萬物進。从日从臸。《易》曰：“明出地上，㬜。”

translation.text: To advance. When the sun rises, all things advance. Formed from 日 and 臸. The Changes says: “Brightness emerges above the earth: 㬜.”

entries.text: The relevant bronzeware inscription form depicts two arrows plus a target, suggesting the firing (and thereby the insertion) of slender arrows into a target → *proceed*; *advance* (← forward motion). Distinguish 晋 from 普. Also, note a variant form 晉, which preserves the visual connection with 至 (arrow) more closely than does 晋, and which appears in derivative characters such as 搢 and 戩.
As per 向# (ventilation hole) + 日 sun/day → aperture permitting the entrance of bright sunlight → *midday*; *noon*. Also, *time* or *moment* (← time marked by the passage of the sun through the sky).
As per 安# (rest in/on) + 日 sun/day → *setting of the sun* (sun resting/settling on the horizon; compare 旰) → *late* (← late in the day); *quiet* (that accompanies the end of the day).
天清也。从日安聲。

translation.text: The sky clear. Formed from 日, with 安 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 兼晐也。从日亥聲。

translation.text: To encompass together. Formed from 日, with 亥 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 西# (align) + 日 sun → objects aligned and exposed to *dry in the sun* → *expose* → *bleach* → *bleached cloth*.
含# contain + 日 sun/day → the sun, as yet contained in darkness but about to make its appearance → *pre-dawn*. Compare 莟, which also features the idea of an object just about to make its appearance.
明也。从日夋聲。

translation.text: Bright. Formed from 日, with 夋 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 莫也。从日免聲。

translation.text: Evening. Formed from 日, with 免 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 日見也。从日从見，見亦聲。《詩》曰：“見晛曰消。”

translation.text: The sun appearing. Formed from 日 and 見; 見 also indicates the sound. The Odes says: “When sunlight appears, it melts.”

entries.text: The relevant seal inscription form combines an abbreviated form# of 書 (written work) + 日 sun/day surrounded by straight lines on all four sides → ( written) demarcation of sunshine from darkness → *noon*; *afternoon*; *daytime*. 晝 eliminates the two vertical strokes toward the bottom of the character.
日之出入，與夜爲界。从畫省，从日。

translation.text: The sun's coming out and going in, forming the boundary with night. Formed from abbreviated 畫 and 日.

entries.text: As per 希# (rare, fine cloth) + 日 sun/day → *dry out* (a cloth by exposure to the sun).
乾也。从日希聲。

translation.text: To dry. Formed from 日, with 希 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 成# (straight) + 日 sun/day → direct sunlight → *shining*; *clear*.
明也。从日成聲。

translation.text: Bright. Formed from 日, with 成 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 甫# (spread) + 日 sun/day → *late afternoon* sunlight spreading over the earth (compare 普 and 昉).
As per 折# (cut) + 日 sun/day → cuttingly *bright*, *clear* light → *clear and fresh*.
昭晣，明也。从日折聲。《禮》曰：“晣明行事。”

translation.text: 昭晣, bright. Formed from 日, with 折 indicating the sound. The Rites says: “Conduct affairs when light has dawned.”

entries.text: As per 吾# (crossing) + 日 sun/day (→ bright) → crossing point between darkness (= ignorance) and brightness (= *enlightenment*; compare 悟) → *clarity*. *Meet* and *have a meeting* are borrowed meanings.
明也。从日吾聲。《詩》曰：“晤辟有摽。”

translation.text: Bright. Formed from 日, with 吾 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “Awake, beating the breast” (晤辟有摽); interpretation of the recorded quotation is uncertain.

entries.text: As per 毎# (dark) + 日 sun/day → *dark*, *moonless night* (falling on the last day of a lunar month) → *hide*; *invisible*.
月盡也。从日每聲。

translation.text: The end of the lunar month. Formed from 日, with 每 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 日出皃。从日告聲。

translation.text: The appearance of the rising sun. Formed from 日, with 告 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 辰# (twitch) + 日 sun/day → *dawn* or *early morning*, when plant and animal life are twitching with vitality → *time* (← time marked by the appearance of a new day).
As per 免# (draw out of/away from) + 日 sun/day → the drawing away of the sun from the sky in sunset → *night* → *late*; *one's later years*.
周年也。从日、卒，卒亦聲。

translation.text: A complete year. Formed from 日 and 卒; 卒 also indicates the sound.

entries.text: As per 並# (long lines) + 日 sun/day → long rays of sunlight (compare 晡 and 昉) spreading *widely* → *generally*; *pervade*.
日無色也。从日从並。

translation.text: The sun without color. Formed from 日 and 並.

entries.text: As per 京# (expansive) + 日 sun/day → expansive *view* obtainable on a bright, clear day → *scene*.
光也。从日京聲。

translation.text: Light. Formed from 日, with 京 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 析# divide + 日 sun/day → divide by making *clear* distinctions → *obvious*. It is also possible that 晰 was devised as a variant form of 皙 white, with clarity likened to bright sunlight.
As per 青# (clean/pure) + 日 sun/day → *clear day* → *clear up*. Note the variant form 晴.
雨而晝夝也。从日，啓省聲。

translation.text: The sky clearing by day after rain. Formed from 日, with abbreviated 啓 indicating the sound.

entries.text: A tripling of 日 sun, suggesting the *brightness* of multiple suns. *Crystal* derives from the compound 水晶.
精光也。从三日。凡晶之屬皆从晶。

translation.text: Pure brilliance. Formed from three 日. All characters in this group follow 晶.

entries.text: As per 咎# (cause to stop) + 日 sun/day → sunbeams stopped by a *sundial*, which casts a *shadow* → *shade*.
日景也。从日咎聲。

translation.text: The sun’s shadow. Formed from 日, with 咎 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 日覆雲暫見也。从日易聲。

translation.text: The sun briefly appearing through covering clouds. Formed from 日, with 易 indicating the sound.

entries.text: The relevant seal inscription form is as per 知# (direct) + an element combining 曰 say/speech indicator and 于, here an abbreviated form of 吁 (exclamation) → speak with *wisdom*, and directly to the point → *knowledge*; *intellect*.
不明也。从日奄聲。

translation.text: Not bright. Formed from 日, with 奄 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 光美也。从日往聲。

translation.text: Beautiful light. Formed from 日, with 往 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 宣# (circle about) + 日 sun/day → *sunlight* warming a circle of objects (compare 晅 and 烜).
日行暆暆也。从日施聲。樂浪有東暆縣。讀若酏。

translation.text: The sun moving slowly, 暆暆. Formed from 日, with 施 indicating the sound. Lelang has Dongyi County, 東暆. Read like 酏.

entries.text: As per 叚# (overlay) + 日 sun/day → figurative overlaying of days/time, creating a surplus → *leisure* (time).
閑也。从日叚聲。

translation.text: Leisure. Formed from 日, with 叚 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 軍# (circularity) + 日 sun/day → *halo*/*corona* encircling the sun → *dizzy* (← effect of staring at a corona) → *confused*; *grow unclear* → *fade* (← fading of clarity). Compare 暉 and 焜.
日月气也。从日軍聲。

translation.text: Vapor around the sun or moon. Formed from 日, with 軍 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 軍# (circularity) + 日 sun/day → brilliant solar halo, radiating at length → *sunshine*; *shine*. Compare 輝 and 暈.
光也。从日軍聲。

translation.text: Light. Formed from 日, with 軍 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 曷# (cut off) + 日 sun/day → *sunstroke* (← have one's vitality or consciousness cut by overexposure to the sun).
傷暑也。从日曷聲。

translation.text: Injured by summer heat. Formed from 日, with 曷 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 旦明也。从日者聲。

translation.text: The light of dawn. Formed from 日, with 者 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 者# (pile of brushwood/firewood) + 日 sun/day → *hot*; *heat*. 暑 was devised to replace 者 after 者 acquired its borrowed meaning.
熱也。从日者聲。

translation.text: Hot. Formed from 日, with 者 indicating the sound.

entries.text: Two once-separate characters combine 耎# (soft) + 火 fire or 日 sun/day, respectively → warm up and soften (by fire or by sunlight; compare the right-hand element of 捏) → *warm/heat up*. The present form, which has assumed this meaning from the others mentioned, combines 日 sun/day + 爰.
As per 音# (indistinct) + 日 sun/day → scant light → *dark*; *dim* → *secretly*; *hidden*; *gloomy*; *ignorant*.
日無光也。从日音聲。

translation.text: The sun without light. Formed from 日, with 音 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 昜# rise + 日 sun/day → *bright sun* rising in the morning sky; *clear sunlight*; *clear*.
日出也。从日昜聲。《虞書》曰：“暘谷。”

translation.text: The sun rising. Formed from 日, with 昜 indicating the sound. The Book of Yu says: “Sunrise Valley.”

entries.text: 冥# darkness + 日 sun/day → *dark* skies (compare 溟).
昜# rise + 申 (stretch) → *stretch* high/long → *proceed smoothly* → *free and easy*.
晧旰也。从日臯聲。

translation.text: 晧旰, bright. Formed from 日, with 臯 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 日頗見也。从旦旣聲。

translation.text: The sun partly visible. Formed from 旦, with 旣 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 斬# (cut) + 日 sun/day → a figurative cut in days/time → *temporary*; *provisional* → (after a) *long time*.
不久也。从日斬聲。

translation.text: Not lasting long. Formed from 日, with 斬 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 莫# (concealed) + 日 sun/day → concealment of the sun at *sunset*/*nightfall* → *become dark* → *end* → *spend time* (← passage of time ← grow dark) → *earn a living*; *livelihood* (← manner in which one passes time ← passage of time). 暮 was devised to replace 莫 after 莫 lost its connection with nightfall.
As per 匿# (objects in a container) + 日sun/day → sunlight contacting objects set out for drying → *intimacy* (← be in close contact). Compare 昵.
日近也。从日匿聲。《春秋傳》曰：“私降暱燕。”

translation.text: To grow closer daily. Formed from 日, with 匿 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “Privately descending to intimate feasts”; the quoted phrase 私降暱燕 is uncertain.

entries.text: The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 日 sun/day + an element combining the curled hide of an animal with the bones still attached + 廾 pair of hands → spread an animal hide and *expose* it on the ground for drying in the sun → *reveal*. The meanings *violent*, *rough* and *sudden(ly)* are either via association (← strip a hide) or are borrowings.
乾也。耕㬥田曰暵。从日堇聲。《易》曰：“燥萬物者莫暵于離。”

translation.text: To dry. Plowing and exposing a field to the sun is 暵. Formed from 日, with 堇 indicating the sound. The Changes says: “For drying all things, nothing exceeds Li.”

entries.text: As per 尞# as described in 僚 (circular continuum) + 日 sun/day → *clear* arch of sky.
進# advance + 日 sun → *advance*/procession of the *rising sun* → *proceed*.
As per 敦# (swarm) + 日 sun/day → sunlight swarming over the earth with the *rising of the (round) sun*; *sunrise*.
As per 壹# (crammed full) + 日 sun/day → cloud-filled sky → *cloudy* → *dark*; *dim*.
陰而風也。从日壹聲。《詩》曰：“終風且曀。”

translation.text: Overcast and windy. Formed from 日, with 壹 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “Wind all day, and overcast.”

entries.text: Abbreviated form# of 概 level off + 旦 (the sun on the horizon) → the sun setting and leveling off on the western horizon → *reach*; *extend to*. Also, *and*, *along with* and *as well as* (← extend to another point/topic; compare 及).
華# brilliant + 日 sun/day → *shine* brilliantly → *thriving*.

厤# is 厂 cliff/shape indicator (here suggesting a roof) + 秝 (禾 grain/rice doubled → sheaves of grain) → count neat lines of sheaves in a storehouse (compare 稟) → manage. 曆 adds 日 sun/day → neat lineup or arrangement of days that enables easy counting → *calendar* → *destiny*; *fate*; *lifespan*; *era*; *period*.
厤象也。从日厤聲。《史記》通用歷。

translation.text: To calculate the celestial phenomena. Formed from 日, with 厤 indicating the sound. The Records of the Historian also uses 歷.

曆.example: 日历 → 日曆; 历史 → 歷史

歷.example: 历史 → 歷史; 日历 → 日曆

entries.text: 雲# cloud + 日 sun/day → the sun obscured by dense cloud cover → *cloud over* → *fog up* → *dim*; *frosted* (glass); *gloom*.
雲布也。从日、雲。會意。

translation.text: Clouds spreading. Formed from 日 and 雲, combining their meanings.

entries.text: 曈曨，日欲明也。从日童聲。

translation.text: 曈曨, when the sun is about to brighten. Formed from 日, with 童 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 日 sun/day + 堯# (arch/rise high) → sun rising over the horizon, which in turn lightens the sky → *dawn*; *daylight*; *daybreak* → *enlighten*.
明也。从日堯聲。

translation.text: Bright. Formed from 日, with 堯 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 鄕 here a variant form of 卿# (be positioned at opposite sides) + 日 sun/day → one day figuratively facing another day through intervening time → *a previous day*; *once (upon a time)*; (just) *before*.
不久也。从日鄉聲。《春秋傳》曰：“曏役之三月。”

translation.text: Not long ago. Formed from 日, with 鄉 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: “In the third month of the earlier campaign.”

entries.text: 萬物之精，上爲列星。从晶生聲。一曰象形。从口，古口復注中，故與日同。

translation.text: The essences of all things become the arrayed stars above. Formed from 晶, with 生 indicating the sound. Another explanation: pictographic, using 口; ancient 口 had a mark added inside, thus matching 日.

entries.text: 商星也。从晶㐱聲。

translation.text: The Shang star. Formed from 晶, with 㐱 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 疾有所趣也。从日出𠦍廾之。

translation.text: To hurry toward something. Formed from 日, 出, and 𠦍, with 廾 supporting it.

entries.text: As per 愛# (hinder) + 日 sun/day → sunlight hindered by clouds (compare 靄 and 靉) → *dim*; *obscure*.
As per 署# (cover like a net) + 日 sun/day → *early-morning sunlight* (covering the earth like a net) → *dawn*.
曉也。从日署聲。

translation.text: Dawn. Formed from 日, with 署 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 蒙# (cover/conceal) + 日 sun/day → the world concealed in *darkness* prior to daybreak.
熏# smoke + 日 sun/day → *twilight*; *dusk* (← time of day when the sky turns hazy as smoke).

As per 翟# (rise high) + 日 sun/day → brilliant light radiating from the rising sun. *Day of the week* is via the assignment of bright celestial bodies to the names of the days of the week ( 日 sun 月 moon 火星 Mars 水星 Mercury 木星 Jupiter 金星 Venus 土星 Saturn).
暴# expose + 日 sun/day → *expose* objects in the sun to dry. 曝 was devised to replace 暴 after 暴 came to be most often associated with the meanings "violent" and "rough."
房星；爲民田時者。从晶辰聲。

translation.text: The Fang stars, which determine the people’s farming seasons. Formed from 晶, with 辰 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 廣# (extend) + 日 sun/day → extensive sunlight (compare 晃 and 旺) → *spacious* → *emptiness* (← empty space).
明也。从日廣聲。

translation.text: Bright. Formed from 日, with 廣 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 楊雄說：以爲古理官決罪，三日得其宜乃行之。从晶从宜。亡新以爲曡从三日太盛，改爲三田。

translation.text: Yang Xiong explains: ancient judicial officers decided a sentence and, after three days, carried it out once its appropriateness was established. Formed from 晶 and 宜. The fallen Xin dynasty considered three 日 in 曡 too excessive and changed them to three 田.

entries.text: As per 義# (blade-like) + 日 sun/day → blade-like rays of the (early morning) sun → *sparkling sunlight*; *the sun*.
曈曨也。从日龍聲。

translation.text: 曈曨, the light before sunrise. Formed from 日, with 龍 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 襄# (insert) + 日 sun/day → *long ago*; *ancient(ly)* (← days inserted between the present and a specific time in the past) → *prior*; *former*.
曏也。从日襄聲。

translation.text: Previously, 曏. Formed from 日, with 襄 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 日旦昏時。从日䜌聲。讀若新城䜌中。

translation.text: The time of dawn or dusk; the wording 日旦昏時 is uncertain. Formed from 日, with 䜌 indicating the sound. Read like 䜌 in 新城䜌中.

entries.text: An abbreviated form# of 驪 (neatly aligned) + 日 sun/day → align objects neatly and *expose to the sun* → *dry in the sun*. Compare 晒.
㬥也。从日麗聲。

translation.text: To expose to the sun. Formed from 日, with 麗 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 一# (fullness) + 口 mouth → mouth figuratively filled with words → *say*; *speech indicator*.
詞也。从口乙聲。亦象口气出也。凡曰之屬皆从曰。

translation.text: A word or utterance. From 口; 乙 supplies the sound. It also depicts breath emerging from the mouth. All graphs in this category contain 曰.

entries.text: A depiction of a curved ruler or measuring implement → *bend*; *curve* → *tilt*; *turn*; *crooked*; *distorted* → *melody* (← tune which alternates high and low notes).
象器曲受物之形。或說曲，蠶薄也。凡曲之屬皆从曲。

translation.text: It depicts a curved vessel receiving things. Some explain 曲 as a silkworm tray. All characters in this group are formed from 曲.

entries.text: As per 申# (stretch) + 丿 (split) → stretch an object in splitting it away from others by means of pulling, dragging or towing → *pull*; *drag*; *tow*.
臾曳也。从申丿聲。

translation.text: The dragging expressed by 臾曳. Formed from 申, with 丿 indicating the sound.

entries.text: As per 丙# (spread) + 攴 action indicator → stretch a rope (compare the derivative character 綆, a rope attached to a well bucket). The meanings *replace* and *change* likely owe to the drawing of fresh well water to replace that which has been used, or dried up. (Still) *more* and *further(more)* are borrowed meanings, as are *grow late* and *stay up late*.
改也。从攴丙聲。

translation.text: To change. Formed from 攴, with 丙 indicating the sound.

entries.text: 出气詞也。从曰，象气出形。《春秋傳》曰：“鄭太子曶。”

translation.text: A word emitting breath. From 曰, depicting breath emerging. The Spring and Autumn commentary says: “Hu, crown prince of Zheng.”

entries.text: As per 匃# (cut off) + 曰 say/speech indicator → cut off another person's speech. Compare 害. *Who*, *what*, *when*, *why* and *how* are borrowed meanings. The derivative characters 褐 and 謁 employ a variant form of 曷.
何也。从曰匃聲。

translation.text: What or how. From 曰; 匃 supplies the sound.

entries.text: The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 者# (pile) + 聿 implement held upright to carve/draw characters → pile of documents comprising a written work (compare 著) → *book*; *document*; *letter*; *calligraphy*; *style of writing Han/Chinese characters*.
箸也。从聿者聲。

translation.text: To set down in writing. Formed from 聿, with 者 indicating the sound.

entries.text: The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 口 mouth beneath a representation# of two slender, oblong sacks (compare 東). Here, the sacks indicate an array of similar, ordinary objects. The combination of elements suggests an array/*group* of ordinary (= low-ranking) officials meeting and conversing → *official*; (low-ranking) *office(r)*; *comrade*.
獄之兩曹也。在廷東。从㯥，治事者；从曰。

translation.text: The two parties in a lawsuit, situated east of the court. From 㯥, those managing affairs, and 曰.

entries.text: As per 冒# (long cloth wrapping) + 又 hand/action indicator → wrap an object with a *long* strip of cloth, covering it → *lengthy*. In the present form, the 目 (eye) element in 冒 is turned sideways; distinguish from 罒 (net).
引也。从又冒聲。

translation.text: To draw out. Formed from 又, with 冒 indicating the sound.

entries.text: A variant of 曾 (*once*; *before*; *at one time*; *formerly*).

A depiction of a cooking pot with a steaming basket atop, from which slender wisps of steam arise and figuratively pile upon each other → *once*; *before*; *at one time*; *formerly* (← prior ← prior wisp of steam).
詞之舒也。从八从曰，𡆧聲。

translation.text: A particle drawing out speech. Formed from 八 and 曰, with 𡆧 indicating the sound.

entries.text: The relevant seal inscription form is an element# doubling 夫 and indicating "stand in alignment" (compare 輦) + 曰 say/speech indicator → circular group of people taking turns speaking → *relieve/succeed another*; *replace*; *exchange*; *substitute for* → *alternate*; *change* → *a spare*; *another* (helping of food etc.). Later, 曰 was replaced by 日.
